title: Why you forget why you walked into a room 🚪
subject: doorway
description:
Where does this happen to you most? 👇

Why do you forget what you came for the moment you walk into a room? A 2011 University of Notre Dame study found the doorway itself is part of the answer: the doorway effect.

Sources: University of Notre Dame News (Radvansky, Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology, 2011), Scientific American, Live Science
tags: why do I forget why I walked into a room
walking into a room and forgetting
why do doorways make you forget

scenes.text: You walk into a room and instantly forget why.
In 2011, Notre Dame psychologist Gabriel Radvansky had people carry objects between rooms, virtual and real.
Walking through a doorway made them forget more than walking the same distance in one room.
But here's the strange part. Going back to the first room didn't help.
